bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
work="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/.worktrees/video-two-topic-operator-20261124"
test -d "$work"
cd "$work"
log="/tmp/gace-two-video-docker-diagnosis.log"
if docker build --progress=plain --target build -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-two-video-topic-operator:20261124 . > "$log" 2>&1; then echo BUILDER_OK; exit 0; fi
if grep -Eiq 'ERR_PNPM_FETCH|network|timeout|TLS|certificate|ECONN|ENOTFOUND' "$log"; then exit 71; fi
if grep -Eiq 'could not resolve|Could not resolve|ERROR.*resolve|Cannot find module' "$log"; then exit 72; fi
if grep -Eiq 'no space left|disk quota' "$log"; then exit 73; fi
if grep -Eiq 'failed to solve|pull access denied|manifest unknown|image.*not found' "$log"; then exit 74; fi
if grep -Eiq 'Syntax error|TS[0-9]{4}|ERROR.*[.]ts' "$log"; then exit 75; fi
exit 76
